description: This file defines the User model class for the Opencart admin system, providing methods for managing user records, including creation, update, deletion, retrieval, and authorization token handling.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Model class for managing user data and authorization in the Opencart admin system.

methods.name: addUser
methods.description: Creates a new user record in the database with provided data.

methods.name: editUser
methods.description: Updates an existing user record identified by user_id with new data.

methods.name: editPassword
methods.description: Updates the password for a user identified by user_id.

methods.name: deleteUser
methods.description: Deletes a user record and associated authorizations and logins.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves user data by user_id, including user group info.

methods.name: getUserByUsername
methods.description: Retrieves user data by username.

methods.name: getUserByEmail
methods.description: Retrieves user data by email.

methods.name: getUserByCode
methods.description: Retrieves user data by code.

methods.name: getUsers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of users based on filter criteria.

methods.name: getTotalUsers
methods.description: Returns total count of users matching filter criteria.

methods.name: getTotalUsersByGroupId
methods.description: Returns total count of users in a specific user group.

methods.name: getTotalUsersByEmail
methods.description: Returns total count of users with a specific email.

methods.name: addLogin
methods.description: Records a new login attempt for a user.

methods.name: deleteLogins
methods.description: Deletes login records for a user.

methods.name: getLogins
methods.description: Retrieves login records for a user.

methods.name: getTotalLogins
methods.description: Returns total login attempts for a user.

methods.name: addAuthorize
methods.description: Creates a new authorization record for a user.

methods.name: editAuthorizeStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a user authorization.

methods.name: editAuthorizeTotal
methods.description: Updates the total attempts for a user authorization.

methods.name: editAuthorizeTotalByUserId
methods.description: Updates total attempts for all authorizations of a user.

methods.name: deleteAuthorizes
methods.description: Deletes authorization records for a user.

methods.name: getAuthorize
methods.description: Retrieves a specific authorization record.

methods.name: getAuthorizeByToken
methods.description: Retrieves authorization record by user ID and token.

methods.name: getAuthorizes
methods.description: Retrieves multiple authorization records for a user.

methods.name: getTotalAuthorizes
methods.description: Returns total authorization records for a user.

methods.name: resetAuthorizes
methods.description: Resets total attempts for a user's authorizations.

methods.name: addToken
methods.description: Creates a new token record for a user.

methods.name: getTokenByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a token record by code, with expiration check.

methods.name: deleteTokenByCode
methods.description: Deletes a token record by code.
